we propose a task-specific Vision-Language Pre-training framework for Multimodal Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis. Specifically, inspired by the recent success of BART-based generative models in text-based ABSA, we first construct a generative multimodal architecture based on BART, for both vision-language pre-training and the downstream MABSA tasks.
